title: Project DETERMINATION
body:
**Record start**
_THIS NEXT EXPERIMENT
SEEMS
VERY
VERY
INTERESTING
...
WHAT DO YOU THINK?_
**Record end**


**Record start**
_I've done it.
Using the blueprints, I've extracted it from the human SOULs.
I believe this is what gives their SOULs the strength to persist after death.
The will to keep living... The resolve to change fate.
Let's call this power...
"Determination."_
**Record end**

**Record start**
Everyone that had fallen down...
... has woken up.
They're all walking around and talking like nothing is wrong.
I thought they were goners...?
**Record end**

The DETERMINATION injected into the vessel allows you to gain the power of an ANGEL.

![Syringe craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec373a3358561569934b4a52cbbafec15dd70c67.png)
![Injection craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28c23e5179ddc85fa1b526176baa50a3b2473ec4.png)
![Injection second craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adc7090a2930b8bd071a800efcd1e93726b34ded.png)

The power of SAVE and RETURN.

![Save Star](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c80d2138365e43a7f44df8082e8b160deec6af7f.png)

![Save screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37440c25514a5b5be895357d3c941a45086130af.png)

But what will happen to ordinary beings if they gain power that does not belong to them? They're called AMALGAMATES.

![Amalgamate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcdbd574f5ede56a67fbdf84beb7bf5478006521.png)
